# PM Ventures Institute

> PM Ventures Institute is a FloLabs Innovations Group institute for product management and project management. Internship interest is routed through FloLabs International.

## Site

- [Home](https://pm-ventures-institute-v1.vercel.app/): Overview of PM Ventures Institute
- [About](https://pm-ventures-institute-v1.vercel.app/#about)
- [Offers](https://pm-ventures-institute-v1.vercel.app/#offers)
- [Projects](https://pm-ventures-institute-v1.vercel.app/#projects)
- [Join us](https://pm-ventures-institute-v1.vercel.app/#join)

## Join

- [Internships via FloLabs International](https://www.flolabs.international/internships)
- Contact: support@flolabs.ai

## Organization

- [FloLabs Innovations Group](https://www.flolabsinnovations.com): Parent organization
- [FloLabs International](https://www.flolabs.international)
